treatment_summary.value: Self-administered ibuprofen; cephalosporin and amoxicillin (not effective); physical cooling and loxonin on admission (not effective); dexamethasone 5 mg (temperature returned to normal). Herpes zoster treated with foscarnet sodium 3 g qd for 7 days, oral cobamamide 1 mg tid, topical acyclovir ointment and calamine lotion. Discharged on loxonin 60 mg tid and colchicine 0.5 mg bid; colchicine stopped for intestinal adverse reactions (diarrhea), switched to tofacitinib 5 mg bid and prednisone 10 mg qd; tofacitinib discontinued 2022-12-25 due to COVID-19 infection, continued loxonin 60 mg tid and prednisone 10 mg qd. Symptom free after about 4 months of treatment and stopped medication.

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Clinical presentation conformed to the diagnostic criteria for PFAPA syndrome after excluding fever caused by connective tissue disease, infection, tumor, drugs and other causes, with an effective result of glucocorticoid therapy; high throughput gene sequencing (DNBSEQ-T7) with Sanger confirmation found a heterozygous TNFAIP3 variant of uncertain significance.

parental_testing_statement.value: Heterozygous variant in TNFAIP3 gene c.63A>T(p. I21 = ) was detected by genetic testing from the samples of the patient, his father and his sister. While no variant in the TNFAIP3 gene was found in the sample of the patient's mother.
